summary: Crook County, OR 75-ft Aermotor steel tower of 1933, abandoned 1964 and removed 1968; a 2013 forum visit found footings and remains of the earlier tree lookout.

notes_for_editor: Build, height, removal and abandonment years agree across the register, firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts. The only account of the site today is one 2013 forum post, so the current condition is unverified; the site's public access is not described in any source read. Brief's design 'Aermotor' and height 22.9 m are confirmed (75 ft). No fires found in the sources read. A 1957 child injury at the station is in the Forest Lookouts quotes but was left out as not about the lookout's history.
